title: Container Bookings: Surcharge, Premium and Desk Fee Rates by Tier
content:
This rate card lists, per Container Bookings product, the fixed charges that sit beside ocean freight: the manual booking fee, the loading guarantee premium, the peak season surcharge and the equipment imbalance surcharge, plus the notice a cancellation needs for the premium to come back. All money figures are in US dollars.

## Rate card

| Booking product | Manual booking fee (USD per booking) | Loading guarantee premium (USD per container) | Peak season surcharge (USD per container) | Equipment imbalance surcharge (USD per container) | Premium refunded if cancelled at least this many calendar days before departure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 0.00 | 0.00 | 400.00 | 175.00 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 400.00 | 175.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 35.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 120.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 35.00 | 185.00 | 250.00 | 175.00 | 10 |
| AHL Premium Express | 0.00 | 420.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 7 |

## How to read a zero

A figure of 0.00 in a surcharge column marks the product as exempt from that surcharge. A premium of 0.00 means the product carries no loading guarantee premium, which is why the refund notice for those products stands at 0. The manual booking fee concerns bookings placed through the customer service desk.

## Tier notes

- AHL Contract Priority bears none of the four charges on this card.
- Only AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express carry a loading guarantee premium, and they differ in the notice required for its refund: ten calendar days for the first, seven for the second.
- The peak season surcharge touches the two spot products and AHL Guaranteed Loading.
